html_read_snapshots.capture_method: Unmodified viewport screenshots of the native ADK 2.4.0 Web UI reading the retained session database. No model invocation or agent rerun.

request.visible_evidence: Function-call popup reads page.html into s, locates job-card, and prints s[i-1500:i+8000].

response.visible_evidence: Native raw-event panel scrolled to job-card markup and the h3 job title within the returned HTML; escaped newlines are part of the serialized response.

html_read_snapshots.limits: The response screenshot shows a scrolled portion, not all 9,501 returned characters. Adjacent events remain visible in the native timeline. These are current captures of saved history, not screenshots taken during the original execution.

first_html_exposure_and_inspection.capture_method: Read-only copy of the retained session opened in ADK 2.4.0 Web UI; native screenshots, with event 19 cropped to its function-call popup. No model invocation or agent rerun.

loader_preview.visible_evidence: Fixture-loader response includes html_preview beginning with the document type and head, before the agent's own file inspection.

first_agent_chosen_file_inspection.visible_evidence: Agent-written Python reads page.html, counts seven candidate markers, and prints counts rather than the source HTML.

inspection_response.visible_evidence: Tool response returns marker counts from the event 19 command.

first_html_exposure_and_inspection.limits: Event 10 is the model's first exposure to HTML, not an agent-chosen inspection; its screenshot shows the beginning, not the entire 2,000-character preview. Event 19 is the first agent-chosen read of the stored file but returns counts, not an HTML excerpt. The old event 21 screenshot remains available as the later targeted-read request.

inspection_lengths.limits: Character counts, not token counts. The excerpt includes a terminal newline. This is one inspection, not the agent's total reading or a measured context/token saving. The feed-every-chunk alternative is illustrative, not a measured comparison run.

inspection_sequence.action: Request the stored fixture and its metadata
Receive fixture metadata and the first 2,000 characters of HTML as html_preview
Search the stored HTML for structural markers
Receive counts for those candidate markers
Request HTML from 1500 characters before the job-card marker to 8000 after it
Parse the HTML and sample two job cards

repair_policy.on_exhaustion: Host terminates the run if still invalid after repair attempt three
repair_policy.evidence_limit: Author-confirmed policy, not a retry-exhaustion test in the recorded run
